blocking_findings.problem: DDL BLOB affinity does not make primarykey values strictly BLOB. Updating an actual matching sharedrow block from BLOB to same-byte TEXT makes parameter-bound BLOB equality miss. check_layout checks only legacy snapshots counts; verify_returned_state treats None as legitimate pruning and can return State reconstructed from valid KV/COW/deltas. Cold audit subsequently rejects the nonBLOB key. This violates the requested strong present-corrupt-index contract; correctState from replay is not proof of this guard.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Bounded typed-key/layout guard before lookup and after last callback, preserving <=64 rows and all old limits; explicit real factory/public hot/historical negative controls for malformed SQL keys, distinct from legitimate missing index.

blocking_findings.problem: SQLite unqualified names resolve TEMP first. Inside existing writer transaction or last same-connection callback, copy valid main sharedrows into a TEMP table named native_io_shared_snapshots, then corrupt the actual main row. Final helper reads the valid TEMP copy; main DDL/schemaVersion remain unchanged, final total_changes fence begins after the callback, and legal small main writes need not poison the VFS ledger. The same shadow technique applies to archive_nodes/native_state_commitments and can defeat a claim that final traversal read the actual persisted main graph.
attack_sequence: For a small fixture, arrange memory TEMP storage or retain a small temp table below spill thresholds.
CREATE TEMP TABLE native_io_shared_snapshots AS SELECT * FROM main.native_io_shared_snapshots.
UPDATE main.native_io_shared_snapshots SET data=X'7b7d' WHERE block=actual_target.
ReturnOk from final callback or invoke the public read on this same connection while its writer transaction remains active.
Final unqualified load can validate old good TEMP data while main physical record is malformed; cold reopen without TEMP objects rejects main.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Use explicit main-qualified authoritative objects or reject bounded case-insensitive TEMP shadows/attached aliases at initial and final no-callback fences; same-connection schema/PRAGMA controls must not be assumed trusted. Preserve legitimate unrelated temp spill/old controls.

transaction_review.positive: in_read_snapshot begins an owned transaction when autocommit or borrows an existing one, rejects observable borrowed transaction loss; rollback error cannot return a State. final_read compares same-connection total_changes/autocommit only during final internal pure reads, not earlier accounting and not foreign data_version.
transaction_review.residual_open: COMMIT;BEGIN IMMEDIATE inside a caller callback can replace a borrowed transaction while autocommit staysfalse and total_changes/schemaVersion remain unchanged. Later actual graph/State validation can validate current content but cannot restore an earlier transaction atomicity. This is an acknowledged capability-boundary limitation also present in arbitrary trusted-owner SQL callback assumptions, not a newly reproduced exploit. Do not claim unique transaction identity proved by tuple equality.
